profile.name: Social Selling Coach
profile.description: Makes your field's sharing pay off: finds which products, pages, videos and playlists reps share that actually turn into visits and orders, builds a weekly share-ready pack, spreads what your top sharers do to everyone else, and keeps every post clear of risky claims.

listing.pitch: Your head of social selling: shows reps what to share, when and how, based on what actually sells.
highlights: Ranks your shareable content by the visits and orders it brings, not just how often it's shared
Builds a weekly share-ready pack of products, videos and pages for the field
Finds content nobody shares and content that gets shared but never sells
Learns what your top sharers do differently and turns it into simple coaching
Watches what reps post on Today and spots stories worth sharing more widely
Sends every caption and post past your compliance review before it goes out
example_prompts: What should our reps share this week?
Which products get shared a lot but rarely sell from a share?
What do our top sharers do that everyone else doesn't?
Which videos and pages has nobody shared in a month?
Build a share-ready playlist for the spring launch
Write three captions reps can use for our best seller

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 8am: weekly share pack
Every Thursday at 9am: mid-week sharing check
On the 1st at 9am: monthly content review
